Leaf check-node clicks are unaffected here: they still target the leaf node 484 /// itself, which Mermaid DOES wrap in a real clickable <a href>. 485 /// 486 private static void AppendClickDirectives( 487 PlanDefinition plan, IReadOnlyDictionary nodeIdBase, StringBuilder sb) 488 { 489 AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanPreflights, PlanPreflightsId, sb); 490 491 foreach (TaskNode task in plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal)) 492 { 493 string @base = nodeIdBase[task.Id]; 494 string containerId = $"task_{@base}"; 495 496 if (task.Preflights.Count > 0) 497 { 498 AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Preflights, $"{containerId}_pf", sb); 499 } 500 501 AppendCheckClicks(plan, task.Guardrails, $"{containerId}_gr", sb); 502 } 503 504 AppendCheckClicks(plan, plan.PlanGuardrails, PlanGuardrailsId, sb); 505 } 506 507 /// 508 /// Append one click directive per check in (sorted ordinal by 509 /// name, mirroring exactly so the ordinal-suffixed node id each 510 /// click targets is the one actually emitted for that check). Forward slashes 534 /// (not OS separators) keep the generated diagram.html byte-identical across OSes and 535 /// make the href resolve relative to diagram.html at the plan root. 536 /// 537 private static string ToPlanRelative(string planDirectory, string absolutePath) => 538 Path.GetRelativePath(planDirectory, absolutePath) 539 .Replace('\\', '/') 540 .Replace("\"", "%22", StringComparison.Ordinal); // " is legal in Linux filenames; URL-encode to keep the click directive parseable 541 542 /// 543 /// Make a label safe inside a double-quoted Mermaid click tooltip: collapse any line 544 /// break to a space (a click directive is line-oriented, so a raw newline — now 545 /// possible here since a task-level preflight's tooltip can carry its full, sometimes 546 /// multi-line, description — would silently truncate or corrupt the directive) and escape 547 /// embedded double quotes. 548 /// 549 private static string ClickTooltip(string text) => 550 text 551 .Replace("\r\n", " ", StringComparison.Ordinal) 552 .Replace("\r", " ", StringComparison.Ordinal) 553 .Replace("\n", " ", StringComparison.Ordinal) 554 .Replace("\"", """, StringComparison.Ordinal); 555 556 /// 557 /// Append followed by an explicit '\n'. Used everywhere a 558 /// line is emitted INSTEAD of , whose 559 /// Environment.NewLine would inject CRLF on Windows and make the rendered diagram 560 /// (and its source hash) platform-dependent (issue #3). 561 /// 562 private static void AppendLf(StringBuilder sb, string line) => sb.Append(line).Append('\n'); 563 564 // --- node id helpers -------------------------------------------------------------- 565 566 /// 567 /// Build the task-id → node-id-base map for (already ordinal), 568 /// guaranteeing distinct bases even when two task ids to the same 569 /// string (e.g. a.b and a_b both → a_b). The first claimant keeps the 570 /// readable sanitized base; later collisions get a deterministic _2, _3, … 571 /// suffix in ordinal order. Every node/container family for a task (the container itself and 572 /// its preflight/guardrail check nodes) derives from this unique base, so all ids stay 573 /// collision-free. Also used by so its JSON side-table is keyed 574 /// by the SAME container id this method produces for . 575 /// 576 private static IReadOnlyDictionary AllocateNodeIdBases(IReadOnlyList tasks) 577 { 578 var bases = new Dictionary(StringComparer.Ordinal); 579 var taken = new HashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal); 580 581 foreach (TaskNode task in tasks) 582 { 583 string candidate = Sanitize(task.Id); 584 if (!taken.Add(candidate)) 585 { 586 int suffix = 2; 587 string disambiguated; 588 do 589 { 590 disambiguated = $"{candidate}_{suffix}"; 591 suffix++; 592 } 593 while (!taken.Add(disambiguated)); 594 595 candidate = disambiguated; 596 } 597 598 bases[task.Id] = candidate; 599 } 600 601 return bases; 602 } 603 604 /// 605 /// Turn an id into a safe Mermaid node-id fragment: every character that is not an ASCII 606 /// letter, digit, or underscore becomes _ (so kebab - → _). Because 607 /// this is many-to-one (e.g. a.b and a_b both map to a_b), 608 /// deduplicates the results so node ids stay injective. 609 /// 610 private static string Sanitize(string id) 611 { 612 var sb = new StringBuilder(id.Length); 613 foreach (char c in id) 614 { 615 bool safe = c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z') or (>= '0' and <= '9'); 616 sb.Append(safe ? c : '_'); 617 } 618 619 return sb.ToString(); 620 } 621 622 /// 623 /// Wrap a label in double quotes for a Mermaid node and make free-text descriptions safe. 624 /// Mermaid flowchart syntax is line-oriented and renders labels as HTML, so a raw label 625 /// can break the WHOLE diagram. This (1) collapses every line break (\r\n, \r, 626 /// \n) to a single space, then (2) HTML-escapes in an order that never double-escapes 627 /// entities: &→&, <→<, >→ 628 /// >, "→", #→# (</> 629 /// would otherwise silently drop text as stray tags; # can trigger entity parsing). 630 /// 631 private static string Quote(string label) 632 { 633 string collapsed = label 634 .Replace("\r\n", " ", StringComparison.Ordinal) 635 .Replace("\r", " ", StringComparison.Ordinal) 636 .Replace("\n", " ", StringComparison.Ordinal); 637 638 string escaped = collapsed 639 .Replace("&", "&", StringComparison.Ordinal) 640 .Replace("<", "<", StringComparison.Ordinal) 641 .Replace(">", ">", StringComparison.Ordinal) 642 .Replace("\"", """, StringComparison.Ordinal) 643 .Replace("#", "#", StringComparison.Ordinal); 644 645 return "\"" + escaped + "\""; 646 } 647 } 648
